c.name: LED Banner
c.translated: This is a translation. If it differs from the Japanese version, the Japanese version prevails.
lp.a1: Scrolling and still text, dot size, fonts, 11 colors and Rainbow, blinking, speed, swiping between messages and saving messages are all free. Any Color (color wheel), two-color gradients, Auto Next and No Ads come with LED Banner Plus.
lp.a2: No. Open it and start right away.
lp.a3: Only on your iPhone. They are never sent to the developer’s servers.
lp.a4: A full-screen ad appears once when you open the app. You won’t see one the first time you open it, or while you’re using the app, such as when your text is scrolling. LED Banner Plus removes ads.
lp.a5: It’s made for iPhone and requires iOS 26 or later.
lp.a6: It’s coming soon to the App Store.
lp.ads_free: Shown when you open the app
lp.desc: An iPhone app that turns your phone, held sideways, into an LED sign. Scroll your words or hold them still. Use it as a fan sign at concerts, to tell someone their car lights are still on, or to say what you need at a hospital or counter without speaking. It plays the moment you open it, and detailed characters like kanji stay sharp.
lp.h1:
Turn your iPhone sideways.
Light up your words.
lp.lead: Type a message and it scrolls from right to left like an LED sign, or stays still if you prefer. Hold it up for your favorite artist at a concert, tell someone their car lights are still on, say what you need at a hospital or service counter without speaking, or show a name at the airport or station. It starts playing as soon as you open it.
lp.p1_p: No login needed. You can skip the first-time intro, and the Plus offer closes with one tap. There’s no free trial, so you’ll never be charged by surprise.
lp.p2_p: Each character uses about 28 dots, and each dot has several brightness levels, so even kanji with many strokes stay readable.
lp.p3_h: Easy to switch at a show
lp.p3_p: Swipe left or right on the playing screen to jump to the next message. No need to stop and pick again.
lp.plans_note: Plus comes as a weekly auto-renewing subscription or a one-time purchase. The weekly plan has no free trial. See the app or the App Store for prices.
lp.q5: Which devices does it work on?
lp.s1_p: Hold up “Wave at me!” or “Notice me!” in glowing letters.
lp.s2_p: Let someone know, in big letters, that their car lights are still on.
lp.s3_h: At a hospital or counter, without speaking
lp.s3_p: When speaking is hard or the room needs to stay quiet, put what you want to say on the screen and show it.
lp.s3_sign: I can't speak, so I'm showing you
lp.s4_h: Pickups at the airport or station
lp.s4_p: Put up the name of the person you’re meeting and hold it at the arrivals gate or ticket gate.
lp.save_note: You can save the same number of messages with or without Plus.
lp.soon: Coming soon to the App Store. Works on iPhone with iOS 26 or later.
lp.title: LED Banner | Scroll your words across your iPhone like an LED sign
pp.abroad_p: Google LLC, RevenueCat, Inc. and Apple Inc. are U.S. companies, and data may be processed on servers in the United States and elsewhere.
pp.ad_1: To show ads and measure them, device information (such as model, OS and language), your IP address, and records of ads being shown or tapped are sent to Google
pp.ad_2: The app asks Google for non-personalized ads. It doesn’t ask for iOS tracking permission and doesn’t use the advertising identifier (IDFA)
pp.ad_3: The contents of your messages are not sent to Google
pp.ad_4: In the EU, the UK, Switzerland and some other regions, a screen asking for your consent to ads is shown through Google’s consent management platform (UMP). You can change your choice at any time in Settings > Ad Privacy Choices in the app. This option appears only for people in regions where the consent screen is shown
pp.ad_5: With LED Banner Plus, no ads are shown
pp.ad_6: See How Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services for how Google handles data
pp.ad_p: The full-screen ad shown when you open the app (an app open ad) is served by Google AdMob, a service of Google LLC. It appears only once, when you open the app, and never the first time you open it. It doesn’t appear while you’re using the app, such as when your text is scrolling.
pp.change_p: When the app’s features or the services it uses change, I’ll update this page. Major changes will be announced here.
pp.contact_p: Questions about this policy can go to the contact page or ryo.tsuzukihashi@tsuzukit.com.
pp.del_1: Deleting the app removes all your messages and settings from your device
pp.del_2: Purchases are tied to your Apple Account. Reinstall with the same Apple Account and tap Restore Purchase to get them back
pp.del_3: If you’d like data sent to RevenueCat deleted, contact me at the address below
pp.desc: Privacy policy for LED Banner. Your messages stay on your iPhone and are never sent to a server. Also covers Google AdMob, used for the ad shown when you open the app, and RevenueCat, used to verify purchases.
pp.h_2: 2. Data that stays on your device
pp.lede:
In short
LED Banner has no accounts or logins, and I never ask for your name or email. The messages you write are stored only on your iPhone and never sent to my servers. There are no analytics. The ad shown when you open the app is served by Google AdMob. I ask Google for non-personalized ads and the app doesn’t use the advertising identifier (IDFA), but device information, your IP address and similar data are sent to Google to show ads and measure them. To process and verify LED Banner Plus purchases, an anonymous user ID and your purchase records are sent to RevenueCat and Apple.
pp.local_p: Your messages are never sent to my servers. They are deleted when you delete the app.

tos.p1: The App offers a paid upgrade, LED Banner Plus. It unlocks Any Color (color wheel), two-color gradients and Auto Next (5, 10 or 20 seconds), and removes ads
tos.p2: It is available as a weekly auto-renewing subscription or as a one-time purchase. The subscription has no free trial
tos.p3: The prices shown in the App Store and in the App are the prices that apply
tos.p4: Subscription payments are charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions on your iPhone. Deleting the App does not cancel the subscription
tos.p5: If you cancel partway through a period, you can keep using the features until that period ends
tos.p6: After changing phones or reinstalling the App, you can get a one-time purchase back by tapping Restore Purchase while signed in with the same Apple Account you bought it with
tos.p7: Refunds follow Apple’s policies. Please request one through Apple (reportaproblem.apple.com). The Developer cannot issue refunds directly
